Academics / GUIDE 01

Make your timetable work for you.

Start with your program requirements, then build a realistic weekly schedule. Course availability and enrollment rules depend on your student status and the current semester.

Reviewed 2026-11-16 · Unofficial student guide

01

Start with the requirements

List your required courses and check prerequisites with your department. Separate must-take courses from electives before planning your week.

02

Read the current enrollment guide

Use the Curriculum Division’s New Student Navigator for the registration process, account access guidance, and common enrollment problems. Record the dates that apply to you.

03

Check the details before adding

Confirm the teaching language, campus, classroom, assessment method, and possible timetable conflicts. Leave travel time between campuses.

04

Verify your final enrollment

After each selection stage, check the actual enrollment result. Save your final timetable and check the instructor’s announced learning platform.

Small things that help

  • Keep a backup elective in case a class is full.
  • A course on your planning list is not proof that you are enrolled.
